title: High computational cost for very long sequences
description: Self-attention's quadratic complexity makes it inefficient for very long sequences. The authors note that to improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, attention could be restricted to a local neighborhood, and they plan to investigate this in future work.
canonical_description: self-attention has quadratic complexity in sequence length, restricted attention needed for long sequences

evidence.quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size r in the input sequence centered around the respective output position. This would increase the maximum path length to O(n/r). We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
